what: The symbol glyph (WebGL) at the left of the logo cell melts into and swaps with several name lines — the symbol glyph and the first letter of the name line (anchor) are drawn on a canvas and baked into a distance field, the melt t is blended through smoothstep, and midway it wobbles with noise by sin(πt)×.025. As the symbol, noise with stickiness 1.14·distortion .05·melt .2 spreads along the diagonal (top left → bottom right) over 6s and clears over 6s after .1s (overlap -2s, one cycle 10.1s). Every two cycles the symbol shrinks over 1.1s (power1.out) from cell height .65 → .25 while moving to the first-letter spot of the name line and melting into that letter, and while the plate vanishes over .7s the side lines come in from x -30→0 (1.1s, .2 stagger, power2.out). After holding 2s, the same timeline is rewound (power1.inOut·power2.in) back to the symbol. intro: if name, the name lines first come in after .2s over .8s (.18 stagger), hold for .7s, then melt into the symbol at 2.6s (loader). Once the symbol settles, fx:done

options.letter: Symbol character, default first character of the anchor line
options.cycle: 1 (default) repeats name ↔ symbol every laps sweeps, 0 only sweeps to the symbol
options.laps: Number of sweep turns before it becomes the name, default 2
options.hold: Hold time by name in seconds, default 2
options.intro: glyph (default — starts standing as a symbol) | name (like a loader, the name comes in then melts into the symbol to start)
options.delay·entrance·each·stay·reverse: intro: name delay .2 · line entrance .8 · line gap .18 · hold .7 · length of melting into the symbol 2.6 (seconds)
options.scale·end: Symbol plate height / plate height when showing a name — ratio to cell height, default .65 · .25
options.visc·dist·fusion·wobble: Stickiness 1.14 · distortion .05 · melt .2 · wobble while melting .025

use: FirstnameMiddleSurname
note: Text color follows the element’s color (read every .5s, and on change it updates in .3s). The glyph child is a hidden slot that only sets the symbol font — without it, the anchor font is used at weight 800. Panel pixel ratio is 1 like the original. Without WebGL nothing is applied, so the name line stays visible

from.where: shared.js SB.logo — header logo (attached to the screen center in the loader, name → symbol, then auto cycle). Original bundle Brand logo (Vl·qse) · Preloader values
